task: Write a Python function that takes an S3 bucket name and returns a list of all object keys in the bucket using boto3, handling pagination.
criteria: Uses boto3 and a paginator (or a continuation-token loop) so buckets with more than 1000 objects are fully listed
Returns a list of key strings rather than the raw API response

task: Write a Python function that sends a message string to an SQS queue given its queue URL and returns the MessageId.
criteria: Calls send_message on an SQS boto3 client with the QueueUrl and MessageBody parameters
Returns the MessageId value from the response

task: Create an IAM policy document that allows read-only access (GetObject and ListBucket) to an S3 bucket named 'my-app-logs'.
criteria: Includes Version '2012-10-17' and a Statement with Effect 'Allow' for s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket
Specifies both the bucket ARN (arn:aws:s3:::my-app-logs) and the object ARN (arn:aws:s3:::my-app-logs/*) as resources

task: Write an S3 bucket lifecycle configuration that transitions objects to GLACIER after 90 days and deletes them after 365 days.
criteria: Contains a Rules array with one enabled rule (Status 'Enabled') with a Transitions entry of Days 90 and StorageClass GLACIER
Includes an Expiration setting with Days set to 365

task: Write a regular expression that matches a valid AWS S3 bucket ARN such as arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket-name.
criteria: Matches the literal prefix 'arn:aws:s3:::' followed by a bucket name of lowercase letters, digits, dots, or hyphens
Is anchored with ^ and $ so that extra surrounding text does not match

task: Write a regular expression that matches an AWS EC2 instance ID, which is 'i-' followed by either 8 or 17 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
criteria: Matches 'i-' followed by exactly 8 or exactly 17 characters in the set [0-9a-f]
Is anchored and rejects IDs with other lengths or uppercase/non-hex characters
